title: More Advancements！！！
description: Add More Advancements，let's make our Minecraft more fun.Version：1.21.1Neoforge
body:
## **Introduction**

1.The current version 1.0.0 has only added 3 new progress updates; more will be added in the future.

For example: getting a diamond pickaxe achieves the goal"Isn't this a diamond pickaxe?"And obtaining a gold ingot achieves"Gold Ingot!"

These can give us motivation to keep playing and prevent us from feeling bored.

2.This project will be open-sourced in the future.（If you want to know why, see the Q and A below）

3.Add more progress.（Made with MCreator）

**4.This mod was created to make our Minecraft more fun, to spark our curiosity and capture our interest.**
